title: Galloyl Group in B-type Proanthocyanidin Dimers Was Responsible for Its Differential Inhibitory Activity on 3T3-L1 Preadipocytes due to the Strong Lipid Raft-Perturbing Potency.
authors: Wang, Ruifeng; Dang, Meizhu; Zhu, Wei; Li, Chunmei
journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
one_liner_zh: 该文研究B型原花青素二聚体对3T3-L1前脂肪细胞分化的抑制机制，核心是脂筏扰动与细胞分化，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合，且方法仅为分子动力学模拟脂质体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: The effects of three B-type proanthocyanidin (PA) dimers covering procyanidin B2 (B-0g), procyanidin B2 3'-O-gallate (B-1g), and procyanidin B2 3,3'-di-O-gallate (B-2g) on 3T3-L1 preadipocyte differentiation and the underlying mechanisms were investigated. The results showed that digalloylated B-type PA dimers (B-2g) strongly inhibited 3T3-L1 preadipocyte differentiation through disrupting the integrity of the lipid raft structure and inhibiting the expression of peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma (PPARgamma) and CCAAT/enhancer-binding protein alpha (C/EBPalpha) and then downregulating the expression of acetyl-CoA carboxylase (ACC) and fatty acid synthase (FAS) factors, followed by B-1g, while B-0g had little effect. The different inhibitory effects were mainly due to the difference in the B-type PA dimer structure and the ability to interfere with lipid rafts. The greater the galloylation degree of B-type PA dimers, the stronger the ability to disrupt the lipid raft structure and oppose 3T3-L1 preadipocyte differentiation. In addition, galloylated B-type PA dimers had greater molecular hydrophobicity and topological polarity surface area and could penetrate into the lipid rafts to form multiple hydrogen bonds with the rafts by molecular dynamics simulation. These findings highlighted that the strong lipid raft-perturbing potency of galloylated B-type PA dimers was responsible for inhibition of 3T3-L1 preadipocyte differentiation.
abstract_zh: 研究了三种B型原花青素（PA）二聚体——原花青素B2（B-0g）、原花青素B2 3'-O-没食子酸酯（B-1g）和原花青素B2 3,3'-二-O-没食子酸酯（B-2g）——对3T3-L1前脂肪细胞分化的影响及其潜在机制。结果表明，双没食子酰化的B型PA二聚体（B-2g）通过破坏脂筏结构的完整性并抑制过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体γ（PPARgamma）和CCAAT/增强子结合蛋白α（C/EBPalpha）的表达，进而下调乙酰辅酶A羧化酶（ACC）和脂肪酸合酶（FAS）因子的表达，强烈抑制3T3-L1前脂肪细胞分化，其次是B-1g，而B-0g影响甚微。不同的抑制效果主要归因于B型PA二聚体结构的差异及其干扰脂筏的能力。B型PA二聚体的没食子酰化程度越高，其破坏脂筏结构和对抗3T3-L1前脂肪细胞分化的能力越强。此外，通过分子动力学模拟发现，没食子酰化的B型PA二聚体具有更高的分子疏水性和拓扑极性表面积，并能穿透进入脂筏，与筏形成多个氢键。这些发现强调了没食子酰化B型PA二聚体强大的脂筏扰动效力是其抑制3T3-L1前脂肪细胞分化的原因。
